product_metadata.title: TBMax Rice Storage Container - 5 Lbs Flour Container Cereal Dispenser with Measuring Cup, Airtight Dry Food Container Bin for Kitchen Pantry Storage Organization
features: 🍚TBMax rice storage container is ideal for storing dry food like flour, sugar, grains, nuts, beans, snack, cereal, pet food etc. The food container normally can hold 5 lbs of rice or 3.5 lbs of flour. Capacity will vary depending on different food

🍚EASY POURING - The rice dispenser features a pouring spout makes it a breeze to dispense your ingredients. Its ergonomic design offers a comfortable grip for easy, one-handed pouring. A measuring cup screwing on the spout make the food measuring easier

🍚AIR-TIGHT FOOD CONTAINER - The lid shut tightly with latches and silicone gaskets to seal in freshness. A great sealed container can keep your food safe from moisture and bugs. Enjoy fresh food every day

🍚CLEAR VISIBILITY & SPACE SAVING - The rice container are designed with transparent bodies, so you can take a glance for convenient food management. The pantry storage containers with slim size is perfect for pantry organization

🍚DURABILITY - The cereal storage container is made of BPA-Free material and durable construction for long-lasting use. Please REACH OUT to us on your order page if having any issues. We would love to replace or refund to make you pleased of your purchase.
